notes_summary: Mid-market SaaS looking to replace internal vector-hosting + ad-hoc LLM calls with Redwood hosted inference for embeddings + reranking. Goal: handle moderate index (~2M chunk vectors) with high QPS (1k-3k queries/sec) and keep p95 end-to-end <200ms while lowering ops burden and predictable cost.
notes:
- Use case: customer-facing knowledge-base + live chat assistant. Primary flow: query -> embedding ANN lookup -> top-K dense candidates -> lightweight reranker call for final ordering.
- Current stack: in-house embeddings pipeline (CPU) + managed vector DB; scheduling headaches during peak. Want hosted embed + rerank to remove infra.
- Index scale: target ingest ~1.5M-2.5M chunks initially. Growth expectation 2x in 12 months.
- QPS / latency targets: planning for sustained 1k QPS with spikes to 3k QPS. SLA ask: p95 end-to-end <=200ms for 90% of queries; cold-cache acceptable higher but want steady-state p95 <=150ms.
- Cost sensitivity: procurement flagged cost-per-query as primary gate. Finance wants predictable per-embedding + per-rerank per-call numbers and estimates for caching impact.
- Model preference: prefer quantized open 7B family for reranker (lower cost) + 1536-d embeddings for retrieval. Open to Redwood-verified performance profiles.
- Routing/fallback: want automatic fallback to cheaper reranker variant when capacity constrained and route to alternate region for DR.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 required, SSO (SAML) mandatory, request audit log retention 1 year. No air-gapped requirement now.
- POC scope agreed: 2-week baseline benchmark (latency + cost), 72-hour sustained QPS run at target throughput, and integration test for SSO + audit log delivery.
- Quotes from call: "We need predictable unit economics — unknown token bills are a blocker"; "Ops time spent on vector infra is our top churn driver".
- Links: perf matrix requested (we provided template), asked for example batching+caching configs.
- Internal champions: Head of ML Eng (Nina Park) and VP Product (Liam O'Connor). Procurement contact: Maya Holt.
- Risks: long security questionnaire turnaround, potential lock-in concerns with vector DB features, reranker accuracy under quantized models.
- Next immediate ask: Redwood to supply 72-hour hosted API test plan, expected delta in cost vs current infra, and a sample canary rollout plan for a gradual production flip.
